Yet the demand for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-what-actually-how-4|COREMERCH guide to digital]] products from Bangladesh grows. Creators in Dhaka, Chittagong, and Sylhet produce ebooks, templates, and software the world wants. The problem? No reliable way to collect payment. This post ranks the top 7 payment options for Bangladeshi freelancers, stripped of hype. Each option is evaluated for sovereignty, cost, and deployability. No workarounds. No temporary fixes. Only infrastructure you control. If you're [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/build-venezuelan-creators-accepting-crypto-payments-until-you|Do Not]]ing a digital commerce stack in Bangladesh, start here.

content.text: The Full List With Context

1. **NOWPayments (BSC Network):** 0.5% fee, 300+ cryptocurrencies, no KYC. Integrates with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Workers. Automatic webhook triggers product delivery on-chain confirmation. Recommended for low-fee transactions under $0.10.
2. **Cloudflare R2 + Solana Pay:** Store product files on R2 (free tier), accept Solana payments directly in wallet. No middlemen. Client pays gas fees (~$0.02 per transaction).
3. **Google Sheets + USDT (TRON):** Manual order tracking in Sheets, USDT payments to TRON wallet. Free but requires manual verification.
4. **Wise Borderless Account:** Multi-currency account with local bank details. High fees (1-2%) and FX markup. Requires manual payout processing.
5. **Payoneer:** Accepts payments from 200+ countries. 2% fee on transactions, 2.5% FX conversion. Holds funds 2-5 days.
6. **Local Crypto Exchanges:** Buy/sell USDT or BUSD via bKash or Nagad. Informal, high spread (3-5%), but immediate liquidity.
7. **Escrow Services (e.g., Escrow.com):** 3.25% fee. Buyer pays first, funds held until delivery confirmed. Slow (3-7 days).
Why Each Item on This List Matters

NOWPayments and Cloudflare R2 are ranked first because they eliminate third-party dependence. Your store runs on infrastructure you own. Google Sheets + USDT works in a pinch but fails at scale. Wise and Payoneer offer temporary solutions but charge predatory fees and lock you into their systems. Local crypto exchanges provide liquidity but expose you to counterparty risk. Escrow services are last resorts—too slow for digital products. The pattern is clear: sovereign infrastructure outperforms rented solutions. Every option above Stripe's rank requires you to build, not rent. This isn't accidental. It's architectural.
The Ones Most Creators Get Wrong

Wise and Payoneer are traps. They appear convenient but impose hidden costs: FX markups, payout delays, account freezes. Local crypto exchanges seem cheap until you factor in spread and volatility. Escrow services destroy customer experience. The mistake? Prioritizing ease over sovereignty. Every platform that "solves" your payment problem today will become your bottleneck tomorrow. The correct approach: deploy infrastructure you control. Use NOWPayments or Solana Pay as payment layers, not platforms. Store order data in Supabase, not Google Sheets. Deliver files from Cloudflare R2, not Google Drive. The difference? You own the stack. They can't shut it down.
Sovereign infrastructure outperforms rented solutions every time.
How to Prioritise What to Implement First

Start with NOWPayments + GitHub Pages. It's the fastest path to a live store. Deploy Stack 01 from COREMERCH's Complete Builder Kit ($197) for a pre-configured solution. Next, migrate to Cloudflare Workers + Supabase for scalability. Avoid Wise/Payoneer entirely unless you have no other option. Use local crypto exchanges only for liquidity, never for customer transactions. The priority is clear: own the critical path. Payment processing, order storage, file delivery—these must be under your control. Everything else is secondary.
Putting the List Into a Deployable Stack

A sovereign commerce stack for Bangladesh looks like this: Cloudflare Pages for hosting (free), Cloudflare Workers for backend logic (free), Supabase for order storage ($0/month tier), NOWPayments for crypto processing (0.5% fee), Cloudflare R2 for file delivery (free tier). Total cost: $0/month until you scale. The Complete Builder Kit provides blueprints for all components. Deploy Stack 02 for end-to-end testing, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, and 5 pre-loaded products. The result? A store that operates without geographic restrictions. No platform dependence. No subscriptions. Full data ownership. This isn't a workaround. It's base-layer infrastructure built for creators Stripe locked out.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose a payment processor: NOWPayments (BSC) or Solana Pay.
2. Set up hosting: GitHub Pages (free) or Cloudflare Pages (free).
3. Configure backend logic: Google Apps Script (free) or Cloudflare Workers (free).
4. Store order data: Google Sheets (free) or Supabase ($0/month tier).
5. Deliver files: Google Drive (free) or Cloudflare R2 (free tier).
6. Test end-to-end: Load 3 products, simulate purchases, verify delivery.
7. Deploy Stack 01 or Stack 02 from the Complete Builder Kit for pre-configured solutions.
8. Configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability (Edge Commerce Stack only).
9. Load 5 products and test again before going live.
10. Monitor transactions via NOWPayments dashboard or Supabase logs.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use NOWPayments without a website?
Yes. NOWPayments provides payment links you can share directly. However, integrating it with a website (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages) enables automatic product delivery via webhook.
What's the cheapest network for transactions?
Binance Smart Chain (BSC) offers transactions under $0.10. Solana and TRON are also low-cost options. Avoid Ethereum mainnet—gas fees are prohibitively high.
How do I handle chargebacks with crypto payments?
Crypto transactions are irreversible. Communicate this clearly to customers. Use escrow services only as a last resort—they add unnecessary complexity.
Can I accept local currency through this system?
No. The system is designed for crypto payments only. Customers must purchase crypto via local exchanges (bKash, Nagad) before paying you.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
Your store remains operational. NOWPayments is a payment layer, not a platform. You control hosting, backend logic, and file delivery. Switch to another processor if needed.
